description: This file defines the Result class used in the OpenMRS logic module, representing the outcome of logic rules, including various data types, constructors for different result types, and methods for data access, comparison, and representation.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Represents the result of a logic operation, capable of holding various data types, including support for list of results, comparison, and conversion methods.

methods.name: emptyResult
methods.description: Returns a singleton empty Result instance.

methods.name: getDatatype
methods.description: Returns the datatype of the result; for list results, it returns that of the first element.

methods.name: setResultDate
methods.description: Sets the result date/time.

methods.name: setDatatype
methods.description: Overrides the default datatype of this result.

methods.name: setValueBoolean
methods.description: Overrides the boolean value.

methods.name: setValueCoded
methods.description: Overrides the coded concept value.

methods.name: setValueDatetime
methods.description: Overrides the datetime value.

methods.name: setValueNumeric
methods.description: Overrides the numeric value.

methods.name: setValueText
methods.description: Overrides the text value.

methods.name: getResultDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the result.

methods.name: toBoolean
methods.description: Converts the result to a boolean value based on its data type.

methods.name: toConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept associated with the result.

methods.name: toDatetime
methods.description: Returns the datetime representation of the result.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Returns the numeric representation of the result.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the result.

methods.name: toObject
methods.description: Returns the underlying object of the result.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Indicates if the result is null or empty.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if the result has any meaningful value.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks whether the result contains a specific concept or matches another result.

methods.name: unique
methods.description: Returns a version of the result with duplicates removed.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this Result and another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the Result.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a result at a specific index.

methods.name: earliest
methods.description: Returns the result with the earliest date.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Returns the result with the latest date.

methods.name: isSingleResult
methods.description: Checks if the Result represents a single result.
